evidence.detail: rs/w/a decodes a waveform/form byte plus start/end values, then decodes a variable number of envelope segment durations and amplitudes from Stream.

Its reset method clears envelope cursor/step state, and its sample(int totalSamples) method advances through decoded segments and linearly interpolates the current amplitude over the requested sample span.
rs/w/b SoundFilter accepts this type during filter decoding so a changing filter envelope can modulate the decoded filter parameters.

candidates.note: SoundEnvelope is the conservative semantic name for this decoded multi-segment audio envelope; it does not claim a verbatim original identifier.

evidence.detail: rs/w/b owns two filter banks with up to four pole pairs each, per-bank frequency/attenuation parameter arrays, static float coefficient work arrays and exported fixed-point coefficients.
Coefficient generation interpolates attenuation, converts encoded pitch to angular frequency, recursively constructs cascaded second-order filter coefficients and applies the global gain to bank 0.

Its Stream decoder reads the packed pair counts, start/end global gain, per-stage frequency/attenuation values and optional alternate values, and delegates modulation-segment decoding to rs/w/a SoundEnvelope.

candidates.note: SoundFilter is the conservative semantic name for this two-bank audio filter/coefficient generator; it does not claim a verbatim original identifier.
